task: T0-7 rule-based PMT ABM re-run (5 seeds)

agent_initial_profiles.csv.note: Committed/tracked in git; loaded because it already exists in the script's own directory (base_path check), so agent initial states are FIXED across all seeds/runs -- seed only affects stochastic decision draws, per-agent flood realization, and yearly grant availability, not initial population or which years floods occur.

flood_years.csv.note: Committed/tracked in git; loaded for the same reason as agent_initial_profiles.csv, so all 5 seeds (and the published Run_1..3) share the same community flood years [3, 4, 9].

hardcoded_params.note: Script exposes only --seed and --output as CLI flags; agent count and year count are module-level constants, not configurable via CLI. 100 agents x 10 years matches the published Group_C LLM single-agent flood runs, so no override was needed.

simulation_log.csv.expected_row_count: NUM_AGENTS * NUM_YEARS = 100 * 10 = 1000 (+1 header line in raw file)

derived_metrics_for_this_run.convention: Pools all 1000 rows (100 agents x 10 years, including repeated 'already relocated' carry-forward rows) into 4 canonical actions (do_nothing/buy_insurance/elevate_house/relocate) via the same fold as reproduction/nature_water/gen_fig3_case2_flood.py's _rulebased_action/_ehe_from_decisions (elevated+insured folds into buy_insurance as the dominant action); EHE = H/log2(4) computed once per run on the pooled distribution.
